issue.title: Decide whether lifecycle status stays in the PDF marker, or write the note now and the marker later

task_type_fields.proposal:
Decide how status changes should reach the PDF while it may be open in Highlights, and
implement the chosen option. Two proposals from the bob-cli-at accept phase are
alternative answers to the same problem, so they are one decision:

1. **Drop lifecycle `status` from the page-1 marker** (or make it informational and
   never rewritten). Most marker writes (~62–68 single-PDF writes in 30 days per the
   research) happen exactly when a reading task changes lane (`next → wip`, `→ read`),
   i.e. while the PDF is open. If the vault note and reading task are the source of
   truth for status, most coordinated writes and holds disappear.
2. **Pending-marker refinement**: when a marker write holds, still write the note,
   reading task, and assets now and leave only the marker pending, instead of holding
   the whole per-PDF sequence. The executor deliberately holds everything today because
   the note's `highlights_marker_base` would otherwise claim a marker state the PDF
   lacks and the next three-way merge would see a phantom marker-side change
   (plan:202610/highlights_coordinated_marker_writes.md "Where coordination sits"), so
   this needs a base/merge model change (`status_sync: pending` already models a lagging
   marker).

Code: `src/native/highlights_ref/marker_write.rs`, `sync.rs` (`execute_pdf_sync_v1/v2`),
`projection.rs` (three-way merge), `marker.rs`. Cost of today's design is recorded in
decisions:open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated ("Whole-PDF holds delay annotation import by
at most one scan"). This is a policy decision: confirm the direction with Bryan and
record a decisions strand before implementing.

Proposed by bob-cli-at.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3 and #4, merged by the bob-cli-at land
agent because #4's answer decides whether #3 is needed).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
The bob-cli-at epic kept the existing marker schema and whole-PDF hold semantics so
coordination could ship safely; changing what the marker stores or splitting the per-PDF
write sequence changes the merge model and needs its own decision.

issue.creation_reason: Most coordinated marker writes and holds come from status-line changes made while the PDF is open; the bob-cli-at accept phase proposed removing them or deferring only the marker, which needs a merge-model decision.

payload.description: Follow-up proposed by bob-cli-at.7; builds on the coordinated marker-write executor, hold vocabulary, and decisions:open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated
Both change how bob writes Highlights PDFs that may be open; a status-free marker would shrink the writes bob-cli-az must coordinate
